text: IT IS truly meet and just, right and profitable for us, at all times, and in all places, to give thanks to Thee, O holy Lord, Father almighty, eternal God, and on the festivity (veneration) of St. Joseph to magnify Thee with due praise, to bless and proclaim Thee. The just man who was given by Thee as a spouse to the Virgin Mother of God, and was placed over Thy Family as a faithful and prudent servant; so that taking the place of the eternal Father, he might guard the only-begotten Son conceived by the shadow of the Holy Ghost, Jesus Christ, Our Lord, through Whom the angels praise Thy majesty, the dominions worship it, the powers are in awe, the heavens and the heavenly hosts and the blessed seraphim join together in celebrating their joy. With these, we pray Thee, join our own voices also, while we sing with lowly praise:
